CustomField.description: This field will be indicate if a state is available to be approved and documented under a BOFI agreement.
CustomField.formula:
IF( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Campaign.Partner_Account__r.Id)), Physical_Address_State__c = 'CA', Campaign.Partner_Account__r.CA_Lender_s_License__c =TRUE), 'Restricted', IF( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Campaign.Partner_Account__r.Id)), Physical_Address_State__c = 'CA', Campaign.Partner_Account__r.CA_Lender_s_License__c =FALSE), 'Allowed', IF( AND( OR( RecordType.Name = 'Broker WC Oppty', RecordType.Name = 'Broker FRPSA' ), Physical_Address_State__c = 'CA', Broker_Account__r.CA_Lender_s_License__c = TRUE ), 'Restricted',
IF( AND( OR( RecordType.Name = 'Broker WC Oppty', RecordType.Name = 'Broker FRPSA' ), Physical_Address_State__c = 'CA', Broker_Account__r.CA_Lender_s_License__c = FALSE ), 'Allowed',
IF(
OR( DATEVALUE(APPROVAL_DATE__c) < DATE(2021,06,11), AND (Physical_Address_State__c = 'CO', DATEVALUE(APPROVAL_DATE__c) < DATE(2023,11,10) ), AND( Physical_Address_State__c = 'NE', OR( DATEVALUE(APPROVAL_DATE__c) < DATE(2023,12,05), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.Legal_Status__c,'Sole Proprietor')) ) ) ), 'Restricted',

'Restricted' ) ) ))))
